title: Jallikattu
desc: Arjun, traumatised by the massacre of his entire family, seeks revenge but gets caught. Later, Ram Prakash, the judge presiding over his case, decides to help him.

title: Meenakshi Thiruvilayadal
desc: The compassionate Lord Shiva decides to send Parvati down to earth to fulfill her obligation towards her devotee, Kanchanamala, the queen of the Panya Kingdom.

title: Tik Tik Tik
desc: Dileep, a photographer, gets involved with three models, Sharadha, Radha and Swapna. When they start dying mysteriously one after another, Dileep becomes a suspect.

title: Lovely
desc: Mahadevan does not believe in love and hates the word, but his daughter Nivedha loves Chandru. In order to get his consent, the couple comes up with an intricate plan and executes it.

title: Kaavalan
desc: Bhoomi highly respects Muthuramalingam and his daughter Meera. While appointed as Meera's bodyguard, he falls in love with a girl he has never met, unaware that she is none other than Meera.
